name: Hyperwood
title: hyperwood.org
shortDescription: Hyperwood is an innovative open-source platform that enables users to craft furniture from simple wooden slats. Inspired by E.F. Schumacher and Enzo Mari, it targets DIY enthusiasts, designers, and small manufacturers. Users can create robust and beautiful furniture with minimal tools and locally sourced materials. An example use case is building a bench or a decorative trough using the platform's algorithms, which provide optimized plans and material lists.
pros: Minimizes waste through optimized material use
cons: GUI not yet developed for broader accessibility
